title: Release v2.14.0 — Checkout service discount overhaul
body: Release v2.14.0 deployed 2026-11-03. Changes: Rewrote discount calculation engine in checkout-service for multi-tier pricing support. Migrated from float arithmetic to Decimal. Updated price_calculator.py rounding logic. Known risk: rounding behavior change may affect edge cases with stacked discounts. Rollback plan: revert to v2.13.2 tag.
